verdict.rationale: n8n ships a dedicated MCP Client node that lets workflows/agents consume tools exposed by external MCP servers, alongside an MCP Server Trigger for the reverse direction, both documented as first-party built-in nodes. This directly satisfies plugging MCP servers into n8n so its agents can use their tools. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP Client node's reliability/tool coverage beyond vendor docs.
